analyst_view.overall: Mid-table, level on 12 points: Hoffenheim (11th) have lost six of ten league games, the latest 1-0 at Frankfurt, and Augsburg (10th) ended a poor run by beating Mainz 3-1. Hoffenheim's defence is stripped: Ozan Kabak got a four-match ban for grabbing an opponent by the neck (counted by the numbers), and fellow centre-backs Robin Hranac and Albian Hajdari are also out, which the numbers don't list. Augsburg beat Mainz without Chrislain Matsima, Noahkai Banks, Steve Mounié and the muscle-troubled Jeffrey Gouweleeuw and Han-Noah Massengo; coach Manuel Baum was sent off in that game. Hoffenheim also host Sturm Graz in the Europa League on Thursday night before this Sunday evening game; no referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals and already add about 6% to Augsburg for Kabak's ban. They don't list that Hranac and Hajdari are out too, leaving Christian Ilzer with none of his usual centre-backs, against an Augsburg side that has scored 12 in six. Augsburg's own defence is also patched up, so I add a small 3%, to about 3.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners and already count both sides' recent corner form (Augsburg have forced few lately, Hoffenheim conceded more). Nothing in the news changes either team's wide play, so I stay at 10.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards and already add about 6% each for both teams' recent bookings. Hoffenheim are frustrated after Kabak's red and Augsburg's last game was heated enough for Baum to be sent off, but there is no rivalry here and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.2 shots, already well above average because both teams have been shooting a lot (Augsburg 118 in six, +21%). Hoffenheim's Thursday Europa League game could tire them a little, but that is a hunch rather than news, so I stay at 34.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target and already add for Augsburg's sharp recent shooting (40 on target in six). Hoffenheim's makeshift back line could let in a few more clear chances, but I have put that into goals, so I stay at 10.6.
